_transcription_note: M6 multi-scene (Hook/Proof/CTA) Blueprint JSON, transcribed from the creatomate-specialist design package (v6.147 build-acceleration lane, agent run ae5924be310089a5b) into the M13 v1 Blueprint schema (docs/creative-library/m13-blueprint-capture-schema-v1.md §1). This is a DESIGN-STAGE instance: no Creatomate template exists yet, nothing here is registered, proven, or approved. Two schema gaps were found while transcribing (see the result doc's §Blueprint-schema-fit-findings) and are surfaced here inline rather than silently worked around: (1) `compatible_ice_format_keys` names a format_key ('video_short_triptych') that does NOT yet exist in ai-worker's format taxonomy -- the schema (registry-schema-v2.md:90, reused verbatim) states 'existing governed format keys only, no new taxonomy invented by a Blueprint', so this field is, strictly, in schema violation by construction until a format_key is minted elsewhere (PK/product decision, specialist open_questions #1) -- flagged, not silently substituted. (2) `composed_of_patterns` is empty: no registered Pattern object in either property-pulse.json or registry-schema-v2.md's Pattern vocabulary covers video-SCENE composition (registered patterns are static/carousel branding+headline patterns only, e.g. pp_branding_strip_v1, pp_headline_block_v1) -- there is no existing pattern_key to cite, so none was invented. `client_slug` is set to 'property-pulse' as a WORKING PLACEHOLDER for this draft instance only, NOT a PK client-scoping decision -- chosen because PP is the only client with proven governed video templates today (video_short_stat, video_short_kinetic) and every evidence citation in the design package (getBrand/brand_colour_primary+secondary conventions) is drawn from PP's live implementation; the specialist's own open_questions #2 leaves client-generic-vs-client-scoped explicitly open. The dormant `sub_sequence_key` seam is null on every element -- per the mission's own instruction and per the specialist's package (which resolved the M13 packet's named M6 (a)/(b) fork as (a): one richer-elements single render, not an N-stitched multi-object sequence), this Blueprint needs NO M13 schema extension; the scalar v1 schema already expresses M6's 3-scene design without modification.
